title: 第121章 血为什么是褐色的
slug: 我一值夜班全院主任都睡不着
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“已经回家了？”

赵护士手里那条腕带还没撕下来，声音先抬了起来。

分诊护士捂着听筒回头。

“120说现场还在倒付款记录，拿走的是同一摊外带盒，里面有没有凉拌牛肉还在问。”

孩子父亲还站在床尾，眼睛一直盯着林野手里那张纸。

后面两辆私家车旁已经围了人。

一个女人扶着车门弯腰吐，塑料袋没接住，呕吐物溅在急诊门口的防滑垫上。保安拎着黄色警示牌冲过去，鞋底在水渍里滑了一下，险些撞到旁边的垃圾桶。

林野没有立刻往门口走。

他把血气纸条往孩子父亲面前压低了一点，只指了其中一行。

“先别只盯肺。你看这一项，高铁血红蛋白，三十四点二。”

男人根本听不懂，眼睛发直。

“这几个字是什么意思？”

孙志强把纸条从林野手里接过去，声音短下来。

“血里负责带氧的东西，被弄坏了一部分。氧气进去了，血送不到地方，人就会发紫、头晕、喘不上来。”

男人嘴唇抖了一下，眼神从监护屏挪到孩子脸上。

孩子还扣着氧气面罩，面罩里雾气一层一层起，又很快被气流冲散。

屏幕上的血氧数字仍卡在八十多。

“那他会不会醒不过来？”

“现在先上氧，儿科、急诊二线和药房都在路上。”孙志强没有给空话，“你就站这边，把手机拿好，先说你们这一桌，还有你家里那盒。别人打包的，我们从付款记录和120那边追。”

父亲点头，手却按错了屏幕，把付款页面退了出去。

赵护士看不过去，伸手在他手机上点了两下。

“别翻乱了。照片在这儿，付款记录也在这儿。你人慌，手机别也跟着慌。”

男人被她说得一愣，反而老实了。

第一车三个人已经被分到留观区外侧。

分诊护士把临时腕带一条一条撕开，声音比平时快。

“吃过卤味摊凉拌菜的这边，只吃烧烤没发紫的那边。嘴唇发灰、胸闷、走路晃、孩子老人，先往前排。”

被扶进来的年轻男人不服气，抬手指了指旁边。

“我就是头晕，先让我坐会儿行不行？我没吃多少。”

马昊把椅子拖到墙边，回头接了一句。

“能坐，但你先别跑。你嘴都紫了，还跟我们客气什么。”

年轻男人想反驳，刚张嘴又捂住胸口。

“就是闷。”

林野听见这句，立刻走过去。

“你吃了什么？”

“烤串，冰粉，还有那盘牛肉。”男人喘了口气，“我就夹了两筷子。”

“有没有喝酒？”

“半杯啤酒。”

“半杯啤酒能把嘴喝成这样？”

男人被问得脸上挂不住，声音小了点。

“我还以为我酒量差。”

林野看了一眼他的腕带，又把话递给孙志强。

“孙老师，这个加心电图，血气带高铁血红蛋白。胸闷的先别排后面。”

话说完，他的视线落到孙志强手里的医嘱本上。

孙志强已经听见了，直接点头。

“胸闷、发紫、站不稳、孩子，先往前放，血气先抽。”

小郑从红区出来，手里攥着两支采血管。

“孩子第二管血已经送了。儿科说五分钟内到，药房问亚甲蓝要不要先送过来。”

Page (1/3)

"Go home already?"

Before Nurse Zhao could tear off the wristband in her hand, she raised her voice first.

The triage nurse covered the receiver and turned back.

"120 said that the payment record was still being reversed at the scene. The takeaway box taken from the same stall was still being asked if there was cold beef in it."

The child's father was still standing at the end of the bed, staring at the paper in Lin Ye's hand.

People had already gathered around the two private cars behind.

A woman bent over while holding the car door to vomit, but the plastic bag didn't catch it, and the vomit splashed on the non-slip mat at the emergency door.The security guard rushed over with a yellow warning sign. The sole of his shoe slipped in the water stains and almost hit the trash can next to it.

Lin Ye did not go to the door immediately.

He lowered the bloody note in front of the child's father and pointed to only one line.

"Don't just focus on the lungs yet. Look at this item, methemoglobin, thirty-four point two."

The man didn't understand at all and his eyes were straight.

"What do these words mean?"

Sun Zhiqiang took the note from Lin Ye and his voice became shorter.

"Part of the thing in the blood that is responsible for carrying oxygen has been damaged. If the oxygen goes in and the blood cannot be delivered to the place, people will become purple, dizzy, and unable to breathe."

The man's lips trembled, and his eyes moved from the monitoring screen to the child's face.

The child was still wearing an oxygen mask, and mist formed layer by layer in the mask, which was quickly dispersed by the airflow.

The blood oxygen number on the screen was still stuck at over eighty.

"Then will he not be able to wake up?"

"Oxygen is on now. The pediatrician, second-line emergency department and pharmacy are all on the way." Sun Zhiqiang did not give empty words. "You just stand here, put your phone away, and talk about your table first, and the box at your home. If someone else packed it, we will chase it from the payment record and 120."

The father nodded, but pressed the wrong screen with his hand and exited the payment page.

Nurse Zhao couldn't see it, so she reached out and clicked twice on his phone.

"Don't mess around. The photos are here, and the payment records are here. If you panic, don't panic with your phone."

The man was stunned by what she said, but he became honest.

The three people in the first car have been assigned to the outside of the observation area.

The triage nurse tore the makeshift wristbands apart one by one, her voice faster than usual.

"If you have eaten the cold dishes from the braised food stall, you can only eat the barbecue without turning purple. People with gray lips, chest tightness, wobbly walking, children and the elderly should go to the front row first."

The young man who was helped in was unconvinced and raised his hand and pointed to the side.

"I'm just dizzy. Can you let me sit down for a while? I haven't eaten much."

Ma Hao dragged the chair to the wall and turned around to answer.

"You can sit down, but don't run away yet. Your mouth is purple, why are you so polite to us?"

The young man wanted to retort, but just as he opened his mouth, he covered his chest again.

"It's just boring."

When Lin Ye heard this, he immediately walked over.

"What did you eat?"

"BBQ skewers, ice noodles, and the plate of beef." The man took a breath, "I just picked up two chopsticks."

"Have you been drinking?"

"Half a beer."

"Can half a glass of beer turn your mouth like this?"

The man couldn't bear the question and his voice became softer.

"I thought I was a bad drinker."

Lin Ye glanced at his wristband and handed the message to Sun Zhiqiang.

"Teacher Sun, this is an electrocardiogram, and the blood gas shows methemoglobin. If you have chest tightness, don't wait in line."

After speaking, his eyes fell on the doctor's order book in Sun Zhiqiang's hand.

Sun Zhiqiang had already heard it and nodded directly.

"Chest tightness, purple color, unsteady standing, baby, put it forward first, and draw out the blood first."

Xiao Zheng came out of the red zone, holding two blood collection tubes in his hands.

"The child's second tube of blood has been sent. The pediatrician said it would arrive in five minutes. The pharmacy asked if the methylene blue would be sent first."
